nodes.rationale: CMake forces FFX_FSR2_API_DX11 ON and DX12/Vulkan OFF, builds FSR2 as static libs, and writes amd_frs.dll into Assets because Space Engineers is a 64-bit D3D11 host.

nodes.rationale: When this pack invents lighting, IsolatedMix energy, or march LOD that the next Anomaly shader will also need, file it on Anomaly rather than keeping it pack-private.

nodes.label: Reactivity Mask Subject to Change
nodes.rationale: The precise configuration and contents of the reactivity mask is subject to change in a future version of FSR2.

nodes.label: D3D11 Blocks FSR 3.1 and FSR 4
nodes.rationale: FSR 3.1 / FSR 4 in the current FidelityFX SDK target DX12 and Vulkan, so they cannot run on Space Engineers' D3D11 device. FSR 2.2.1 is the latest fully open-source AMD temporal upscaler that does.

nodes.label: FFX_SC_VK_BASE_ARGS
nodes.rationale: Vulkan pass permutations compile through glslang as compute shaders targeting vulkan1.1 with FFX_GLSL=1.

nodes.label: FSR2_AUTO_COMPILE_SHADERS
nodes.rationale: When set, permutation generation is a dependency of the VK API library; otherwise a standalone shader target is created.

nodes.label: AnomalyAcceptance Harness
nodes.rationale: Links the production reflection consumer and reset policy. Does not exercise D3D, FRS, or certify rendered image quality.

nodes.label: Binding Evidence
nodes.rationale: A snapshot of the last submission, not a promise the current registry still matches.

nodes.label: Camera Cut Reset
nodes.rationale: Teleport and rotate abruptly. Require camera-cut or invalid-history reset on the first evaluated post-cut frame, no old-scene history trail, then reset=none. Check AfterUpscale only on success.

nodes.label: Anomaly CameraOnly Velocity
nodes.rationale: Camera-only paths cannot reproduce independent object motion; use as a control rather than expecting object reprojection to pass.

nodes.label: Ghosting Acceptance
nodes.rationale: Require no persistent duplicate edge after motion stops and no regression on static voxels. Annotate disocclusion/reactive-mask limitations separately. Visual responsiveness alone is not a pass.

nodes.label: In-Game Acceptance
nodes.rationale: Use the same scene, FRS mode, jitter settings and exposure for every comparison. GPU captures of consecutive-frame textures are required; debug colors are not numeric evidence.

nodes.label: Legacy Flags 7 Fallback
nodes.rationale: Legacy 7 and unknown flags fall back. Legacy flags 7 must never reach FRS.

nodes.label: FRS Motion Vector Scale
nodes.rationale: FRS motion-vector scale is (+1,+1).

nodes.label: Reprojection Acceptance
nodes.rationale: For a tracked point moving +3 internal pixels horizontally, require MV=(-3,0). Reproject with currentPixel+MV. Proposed: stationary median error <=0.1 pixel and tracked-point error <=0.5 pixel. Camera-only paths cannot reproduce independent object motion and are a control, not an object-reprojection pass.

nodes.label: Resolution Reset
nodes.rationale: Require rejection of old-size buffers, a resolution/configuration/history reset, then the new texture identity and matching internal dimensions at FRS. Confirm no stretch-history artifact, crash, or disposal of the producer texture.

nodes.label: Show Status
nodes.rationale: Show Status is available in Release; Debug builds also sample evidence in the log.

nodes.label: Source and Probe Changes
nodes.rationale: Require a source reset even when switching between Anomaly modes. Enable each probe and verify explicit camera fallback; turn probes Off and allow producer history to settle before numerical captures.

nodes.label: Velocity Convention 15
nodes.rationale: Required convention is exactly 15: unjittered, internal pixel units, Y down, current-to-previous. previousPixel = currentPixel + motion.

nodes.label: VelocityProbe
nodes.rationale: VelocityProbe must be readable and Off. Anomaly does not expose producer frame IDs or frame-latched probe state, so freshness across a probe toggle cannot be proved from this API. Keep probes Off for captures.

nodes.label: Anomaly Consumption Acceptance
nodes.rationale: Checked September 6, 2026 against the local Anomaly checkout. GitHub fetches were unavailable, so this validates the local update rather than a published release.

nodes.label: Skip 16-bit Luminance Pyramid
nodes.rationale: The compute luminance pyramid pass is compiled with FFX_HALF=0 only; other VK passes permute FFX_HALF={0,1}.

nodes.label: Catalog Not Velocity Fallback
nodes.rationale: The catalog cannot certify conventions and is no longer a velocity fallback.

nodes.label: Fail Closed Probe Metadata
nodes.rationale: Missing probe metadata fails closed.

nodes.label: Color Picker
nodes.rationale: Opaque color uses a swatch plus 6-digit hex (00FFFF cyan) with no alpha channel.

nodes.label: Color With Alpha
nodes.rationale: Alpha-capable color uses a swatch plus 8-digit hex (00000055) so opacity is part of the stored value.

nodes.label: Keybind Control
nodes.rationale: Binding readout shows none plus three adjacent modifier pads, so an unbound chord is visible without a captured key.

nodes.label: Config Demo Dialog
nodes.rationale: Documentation screenshot of a dismissible dark-theme settings modal titled Config Demo. It is a control-catalog example, not a live game HUD: every supported settings widget is shown once, labels on the left and editors on the right, with a close X and a right-edge scrollbar.

nodes.label: Label-Left Control-Right Row
nodes.rationale: Every setting is a two-column row: name on the left, editor on the right, so mixed widget widths still align as a form.

nodes.label: Orange Section Headers
nodes.rationale: Settings are grouped under orange underlined headers so related controls scan as blocks instead of one undifferentiated list.

nodes.label: Fail Closed on FSR Errors
nodes.rationale: The native host fails closed on FSR 2 error codes and defaults to off.

nodes.label: FSR2 README Hero Screenshot
nodes.rationale: Official AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution 2 README still: a photorealistic real-time courtyard frame used to advertise temporal upscaling quality, not a photograph.

nodes.label: High-Frequency Temporal Reconstruction
nodes.rationale: This still is a quality-stress frame: woven cloth weave, thin ivy silhouettes, gold trim highlights, and hard sun/shadow contrast show whether temporal upscaling keeps subpixel detail without ghosting or blur.

nodes.label: FSR2 Replaces Separate TAA
nodes.rationale: FSR2 already reconstructs from previous frames, so a separate temporal antialiasing pass is no longer needed.
